confirmedFindings.title: Immediate DROP TABLE Without Month Validation
confirmedFindings.body: The partition drop query builder removes the safeguard checking whether the table name is older than the retention cutoffMonth, allowing active or future billing partitions to be permanently dropped.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Verify that tableName strictly precedes the retention cutoff date before constructing DROP TABLE statements.
